chapter: Medicine show, hoboing and train songs
title: Hobo songs and the 'I'm the bum and you bum the bum' joke
summary: Nash recalls sad hobo songs sung by men waiting for trains and tells a joke about a bum begging door to door.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well now did you hear any songs when you were riding on the train? Did those guys sing songs? Any of the other guys that were hoboing?

Well yeah I heard some guys. Guys should sing. Sing a lot of old sad songs about sitting at the water tank waiting for a train. A lot of them hobo songs they used to sing. Another guy was cracking jokes. So he went to a house and he knocked on the door. The lady said, bum bum you been here before. And he said that. Let me see how you had to say. Hey you knocked on the door. The lady came to the door and said good morning mum. She said good morning bum. I said well mum I just got in. She said well you can get right out again. So he went on to the next house. His buddies were sitting on the railroad waiting for him. Figured he was going to bum a handout see. He goes to the next house. Good morning mum. Good morning bum. Ah mum I just got in. You can get right out again. And he went on. Went to the next house. He knocked. Good morning mum. She said good morning bum. I said mum do you have a handout you can pass out. He says yes. He says I have the egg in a pork chop. He says it's just about 20 minutes before my husband get off from waking. So goodbye bum. He said goodbye mum. He goes to the next house. He knocked on the door. And the lady came to the door. Good morning mum. She said good morning bum. I said mum does you have a handout you can pass out. He says yes. Come around the back. I think I can get you something to eat. And she got him. Fill him up with big old bag with ham skin. Boiled ham bones. And stale bread. Fresh bread. All kinds of bread. So he wound up on the railroad where his buddy was. When he gets out of there. His buddy says oh for Christ's sake. Boy you hit the right house that time. And he said sir what's the matter with you. For Christ's sake. He said you bigger bum than what I am. He says I'm the bum and you bum the bum. That makes you bigger bum than me. I'm the bum and you bum the bum. Well he was a bigger bum than what he was.
